the installed group drawn as a filled coloured circle defined in a key instead of an atom label: grey-purple halogen dot (crops 01, 05), magenta aryl dot (crop 01)

step names in italic over a thin grey rule above the arrow (crop 01)

notes.compound_label_face: molecules are named (LIMKi3, VH032, 4V) rather than numbered in the crops. Crop 06 (a scheme) sets its names in bold, but it is the only scheme crop that names compounds; the structure panels (crops 03, 04) set names in plain type. With no two scheme crops agreeing, the value stays null.
notes.yield_placement: only crop 01 gives yields (44% isolated yield under the product), so the two-crop rule keeps this null. The reaction_scheme section carries yield_format from crop 01.
notes.conditions_split: crop 01 puts reagents above and time and temperature below for one step and everything above for the next, so the crop does not agree with itself; no other crop shows a split. Kept null.
notes.arrow_style: plain in crops 01 and 05; crop 06 uses a thick tapered block arrow. Two of three scheme crops agree, so plain stands with crop 06 as the exception.
notes.arrow_length_over_bond_length: spread across crops: crop 05 shaft about 79 px over a bond of about 25 px (about 3.2); crop 01 shaft about 35 px over a bond of about 13 px (about 2.6). The earlier 4.2 came from a 105 px arrow that crop 05 does not show. Recorded as 3.0, the mean of the two.
